title: ieee80211: Support decrypting Fast BSS Transition with roaming
description:
Support decrypting captures with Fast BSS Transition roaming present
by now also scanning (re)association frames for relevant information
elements and feeding it into the dot11decrypt engine.

Both (re)association request and response frames are scanned to allow
for potentially missing one frame and still be able to derive PTKs
needed for successful decryption.

Closes #17145

I couldn't merge this branch: CI failed!

The failed windows build appears to be a valid error:
    84>C:\builds\wireshark\wireshark\epan\dissectors\packet-ieee80211.c(33071,42): warning C4244: '=': conversion from 'const guint16' to 'guint8', possible loss of data 

Not only is precision lost but I've actually mistaken the whdr->type to be subtype (guint8) rather than type_subtype field (guint16 size). From a quick look it does not seem to do much harm, maybe on systems with revered byte order, but let me look into it a bit more and fix the reported warning.

Can I somehow trigger the Windows build myself? I currently have no Windows build environment to build it locally.
Hi Mikael, if you push a another commit, there is another build of CI (Windows/Linux) will be launch

Alexis, thanks. Then I'll push with a minor correction.

What I've noticed is that a number of builds are triggered right away when pushing to my local fork, though no build is triggered for Windows. That appears to happen only once you decide to merge back to master. That's why I asked if I can somehow trigger this build myself somehow to sort out things like this before you even need to look at my code.
